title: Keyturn Guest Protection Plan: Schedule of Fee Terms by Level
content:
Every level of the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan is written with its own fee terms, and this schedule
records them level by level. The daily amount is the protection fee for each day of the trip; the share of the
trip price is the same fee expressed as a percentage of what the trip costs; the charging basis states how the
fee is arrived at; the floor is the least the fee may come to for one trip; the ceiling recorded and the billing
point recorded are the terms of those names standing against the level; and the minimum charge days are the
shortest period the fee is charged for however short the trip.

| Protection level | Daily amount (USD) | Share of trip price (percent) | Charging basis | Floor for one trip (USD) | Ceiling recorded (USD) | Billing point recorded | Minimum charge days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Declined Protection | 0.00 | 0 | a daily flat amount | 0.00 | 0.00 | at booking | 0 |
| Keyturn Minimum Protection | 14.00 | 15 | the greater of the daily amount and the share of the trip price | 14.00 | 950.00 | at booking | 1 |
| Keyturn Standard Protection | 26.00 | 25 | the greater of the daily amount and the share of the trip price | 26.00 | 1600.00 | at booking | 1 |
| Keyturn Advantage Protection | 38.00 | 35 | the greater of the daily amount and the share of the trip price | 38.00 | 2400.00 | at the start of the trip | 1 |
| Keyturn Premier Protection | 52.00 | 45 | the greater of the daily amount and the share of the trip price | 52.00 | 3600.00 | at the start of the trip | 1 |
| Keyturn Business Traveler Protection | 64.00 | 40 | a daily flat amount | 64.00 | 5200.00 | daily in arrears | 1 |

## Reading the schedule

The same terms read across the ladder rather than down it. Four of the six levels arrive at the fee as the
greater of the daily amount and the share of the trip price; Keyturn Declined Protection and Keyturn Business
Traveler Protection are written on a daily flat amount alone. The floor recorded against a level equals that
level's daily amount at every level, so a trip of one charged day on Keyturn Standard Protection meets its
floor of 26.00 USD exactly. Keyturn Declined Protection is the only level whose daily amount, share of the trip
price, floor, ceiling and minimum charge days all stand at zero.

## Points of judgement on the recorded terms

**Where a level's recorded ceiling stands at 0.00 USD.** Only Keyturn Declined Protection is written that way,
and it is the same level whose daily amount and share of the trip price are nil; the ceilings recorded against
the other five levels rise with the ladder, from 950.00 USD on Keyturn Minimum Protection to 5200.00 USD on
Keyturn Business Traveler Protection.

**Where two levels share a daily amount and differ elsewhere.** No two levels of the Keyturn Guest Protection
Plan share a daily amount; the share of the trip price, however, does not rise monotonically, since Keyturn
Premier Protection is written at 45 percent and Keyturn Business Traveler Protection at 40 percent while the
latter carries the higher daily amount of 64.00 USD.
